factor_b_loss_in_simulation_and_analytic.wakis_subcell_thin_sheet_note: wakis/subcell.py implements dielectric/permeable thin sheets (eps_r, mu_r) via normal- and tangential-component cell harmonic/arithmetic averaging; finite-conductivity surface-impedance (SIBC) copper sheets are not implemented, so dielectric loss is tested directly in-simulation via solver.sigma = omega * eps_0 * eps_r * tan_delta = 0.00846 S/m and copper + dielectric line attenuation (0.104 dB/cell) is tested on the extracted element excitations.
